pages.text: The falling river exposed sharp stones. They could not walk there barefoot.
A big rock stood at the far end. Mina pointed. "Let's all go to that rock today!"
Raju's shoes were big and thick. Mina put them on, feet loose inside. Raju wore spare shoes from the water's edge.
They entered the stony ground. Mina's shoes kept slipping off.
Mina stopped to adjust them. Raju and Sonu moved far ahead.
One shoe stuck tightly between stones. Standing on one foot, Mina pulled. The big rock was still far away.
Mom brought Mina's own shoes. "Shoes bigger than your feet keep coming off."
Mina changed. Their own shoes fitted just right.
Mina strode over the stones. All three stood side by side on the rock. The wind was cool.
